build_steps.command: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl clang llvm libbpf-dev libelf-dev protobuf-compiler cmake libssl-dev gcc-multilib pkg-config && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

commands: RUN curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable --profile minimal
RUN source $HOME/.cargo/env && rustup toolchain install nightly --profile minimal
RUN source $HOME/.cargo/env && rustup component add rust-src --toolchain nightly

build_steps.description: Build Rust dependencies and eBPF programs

notes: Image is built with Buildah. eval.sh and tests are runtime-mounted verifier assets, not baked into the image. The repo_setup.sh script materializes /workspace from git. setup_runtime.sh builds all Rust dependencies and eBPF programs.
